harvestIndicators: Pick fresh young leaves and flowers throughout the season
Leaves and flowers from stressed plants taste stronger
notes: Trap crop for aphids and squash bugs. Sacrificial host — interplant at pumpkin block edges.

seasonalTasks.title: Cut back leggy nasturtiums
seasonalTasks.body: If the plants decline or get leggy in summer, cut them back lightly for new growth the rest of the season.
